questions.question: The trailer hand valve:

options.text: Should always be used for parking.
Should only be used for parking on a downgrade.
Should never be used for parking.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should never be used for parking.
questions.explanation: Never use the trailer hand valve for parking. It can release air from the braking system and let the brakes go. Use the parking brake or wheel chocks instead.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve should not be used while driving because:

options.text: It will disconnect from the vehicle.
You will stop the vehicle too quickly.

questions.explanation: Do not use the trailer hand valve while driving. Using it while the vehicle is moving can cause the trailer to skid.

questions.question: If you cannot back your trailer in a straight line, you should:

options.text: Swerve back and forth while backing.

questions.explanation: If you cannot back in a straight line, back along a curved path toward the driver's side. This gives you the best view while backing.

questions.question: When backing up your tractor to couple it to a trailer, the trailer brakes should be:
questions.explanation: Before backing your tractor under the trailer to couple it, lock the trailer brakes. This is a key step in safely coupling combination vehicles.

questions.question: After your pre-trip inspection, you should ensure that the:
questions.explanation: Before driving, open the emergency line and service line shut-off valves to check that air reaches all brakes. Listen for escaping air. Then close both valves before you start driving.

questions.question: What is a bobtail tractor?

options.text: A tractor attached to two trailers

questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is a tractor without a semi-trailer attached. Driving a bobtail tractor requires extra caution.

questions.question: When glad hands are coupled, the seals should be pressed together at a ____ angle.
questions.explanation: When coupling glad hands, press the seals together at a 90-degree angle.

questions.question: The emergency air line supplies air to the:
questions.explanation: The emergency air line (also called the supply line) does two things. It supplies air to the trailer air tanks and controls the emergency brakes on combination vehicles.

questions.question: Put the trailer air supply control in "emergency" position to test:
questions.explanation: Test the trailer emergency brakes before your trip. First make sure the trailer rolls freely. Then pull out the trailer air supply control (or place it in "emergency" position). Pull forward slightly with the tractor. The trailer should not move.

questions.question: The "crack-the-whip" effect can:
questions.explanation: The "crack-the-whip" effect can cause trailers to tip over. The last trailer in a combination is most likely to tip. Know your vehicle's movement patterns and drive carefully.

questions.question: Older trailers do not have spring brakes. What happens if the air supply leaks away from the air braking system?

options.text: The trailer will have no brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer will have no brakes.
questions.explanation: Older trailers do not have spring brakes. If the air supply leaks away, the trailer will have no working brakes. The wheels will turn freely.

questions.question: When testing ____, you should use the hand control to apply brakes while moving the vehicle forward slowly.
questions.explanation: To test the trailer service brakes, first make sure the air pressure is normal and release the parking brake. Move the vehicle forward slowly and apply the brakes with the hand control. If working properly, you will feel the brakes activate.

questions.question: What happens if anti-lock brakes are on only one axle?

options.text: It will not make a difference in braking.
It will give you better control when braking.
It will likely cause the air brakes to fail.

questions.correctAnswerText: It will give you better control when braking.
questions.explanation: If a vehicle has anti-lock brakes on just one axle, the driver will have more control during braking than without any anti-lock brakes.

questions.question: Bobtail tractors are ____ to stop than tractors attached to full semitrailers.
questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor has no semitrailer attached. When driving a bobtail, stopping is more difficult. It will take a longer distance to stop than a tractor with a loaded semitrailer.

questions.question: If you must cross traffic while driving a combination vehicle, you should:

options.text: Assume other drivers will make room for your vehicle.
Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to safely cross.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles need more road space than other vehicles. When crossing traffic, you must wait for a large enough gap to safely do so.

questions.question: If a trailer begins to jackknife, the driver:

options.text: Should not apply the trailer hand brake.
Can straighten the trailer using the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should not apply the trailer hand brake.
questions.explanation: If a trailer jackknifes, release the brakes so the trailer wheels can grip the road again. Do not apply the trailer hand brake. Applying brakes is what caused the wheels to lock in the first place.

questions.question: A trailer that is too high:
questions.explanation: Before coupling a tractor and trailer, check the trailer height. If it is too low, the trailer nose may be damaged. If it is too high, it may not couple correctly.

questions.question: The trailer hand valve should be used:

options.text: To check the connection between the trailer and tractor.

questions.explanation: The trailer hand valve operates the trailer brakes and should only be used for testing. Using it while driving can cause a skid.

questions.question: If the emergency air line loses pressure:

options.text: The tractor protection valve will close.
The rear trailer will detach from the combination.

questions.correctAnswerText: The tractor protection valve will close.
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve protects the trailer brakes if the trailer breaks away or develops a leak. If air pressure is lost in the emergency line, the tractor protection valve will close and the emergency trailer brakes will activate.

questions.question: Keeping cargo centered on a rig can:
questions.explanation: A rollover is more likely if cargo is unevenly loaded. Keep the load as centered as possible to help prevent a rollover.
